description: Source code for the SqlCommandWebhookStore class, implementing storage and management of command webhooks in Mattermost.

classes.name: SqlCommandWebhookStore
classes.description: Implements storage operations for command webhooks, including save, get, try use, and cleanup functionalities.

methods.name: newSqlCommandWebhookStore
methods.description: Constructor function to initialize a new SqlCommandWebhookStore instance.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves a new command webhook to the database after validation.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a command webhook by ID if it exists and is within the valid lifetime.

methods.name: TryUse
methods.description: Attempts to increment the use count of a webhook if below the specified limit.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Deletes expired command webhooks based on their creation time.
